name: card
title: Card
description: A bounded surface with a hairline border and optional subtle shadow. v0.12.1 introduced the corner-clip contract — padding='none' auto-clips edge-touching children to the rounded shape. v0.12.4 closed the trade-off the corner-clip introduced for descendant focus rings: the global :focus-visible rule now pairs outline 2px solid lime-a64 + offset 1px (structurally immune to ancestor overflow:hidden) with the existing soft box-shadow halo, so focus rings on Pagination buttons and other interactive descendants inside <Card padding='none'> stay visible. The v0.12.4 Combobox portal migration also means a hand-rolled Combobox dropdown inside <Card padding='none'> now escapes the clip exactly like Radix-portaled chrome already did.
